thread:
tara: FYI, pyright is failing in CI because some generated async client methods return `Iterator[...]` instead of `AsyncIterator[...]`. Repro attached.

tara: generated snippet:```python
class ConversationsClient:
    async def stream_messages(self, conv_id: str) -> Iterator[str]:
        resp = await self._raw_stream_request(conv_id)
        for chunk in resp:
            yield chunk.text
```

nate: oof. The generator emitted the sync iterator type. We need it to produce `AsyncIterator` when `client.is_async` is true.

lucy: also seeing `list[str]` in generated code which breaks on py3.8 CI runners. We should add `target_python_version` toggle and fallback to `List[str]` when target < 3.9.

patrick: another small but painful one: missing `from __future__ import annotations` causes forward-ref noise; adding it fixes mypy/pyright in many cases.

nate: plan: 1) change template so streaming return type is `AsyncIterator[T]` when async client. 2) add future annotations at top of modules. 3) switch to typing.List for py3.8 target. I'll add tests for pyright and mypy.

lucy: I sketched tests in the draft branch that generate an async client and assert the signature contains `AsyncIterator`. I'll push that after the template change.

ci-bot: quick-typing-check: pyright errors drop from 12 -> 0 on changed files in draft branch. Full CI queued.

tara: thanks. One more: some endpoints modeled as SSE use `Iterable` in spec; make sure we only convert Iterable->AsyncIterable for async clients, not always.

nate: agreed. We'll gate conversion on the client runtime flag. Also ensure we import AsyncIterator/AsyncIterable from typing or typing_extensions depending on target.

patrick: can someone add a short note in CONTRIBUTING about running pyright locally and the target_python_version option? New contributors keep missing this.

lucy: will do. I'll open a PR with template fixes + tests + docs -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/3512 :eyes:

tara: great, thanks all. Once merged let's cut a micro release so downstream teams get the typing fixes quickly. :rocket:
